messages.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

Short answer: Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the early laboratory RF validation bench, before field link validation and commercialization readiness, because the cited RF component/semiconductor workflow places R&S signal generation and FSW spectrum analysis in the “laboratory RF test” phase that measures G/T, NF, Tx power, and link equation items around PA/LNA/modem components [26].
### Where they fit in the RFIC validation workflow
The cited semiconductor/RF component context lists Qorvo, Analog Devices, Skyworks, MediaTek M80, SatixFy Sx3099, and Prime ASIC in an RF component / semiconductor section [24].  
The cited OneWeb UT validation workflow is divided into month 1–3 laboratory RF test, month 3–5 field link validation, and month 5–7 commercialization readiness [26].  
The laboratory RF test phase includes G/T, NF, Tx power, link equation measurements, and mentions Qorvo PA, Analog Devices LNA, MediaTek M80, and Rohde & Schwarz SMW6 / R&S FSW [26].  
Therefore, for an RFIC validation use case, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer belong in the lab RF test and debug bench before field link validation [26].  
### Role of the signal generator
The signal generator provides controlled RF/vector-modulated stimulus into the receiver, transmitter, or RF front-end under test, as shown by OTA reference sensitivity testing where the R&S SMW200A sends a 5G NR test signal and throughput is measured [34].  
Receiver tests list R&S SMW200A and R&S SMBV100B as vector signal generators, and the receiver tests need the 5G NR software option R&S SMW200A-/SMBV100B-K144 [41].  
For receiver dynamic range testing, the receiver is evaluated while an AWGN interfering signal is present inside the received channel bandwidth [46].  
For adjacent channel selectivity, the receiver is evaluated while an adjacent-channel interfering signal is present at the assigned channel frequency [47].  
For in-band blocking, the NR interfering signal center frequency is scanned in 1 MHz steps, and narrow-band blocking uses an interfering signal containing one resource block [45].  
For out-of-band blocking, the CW interferer can be supplied by the SMW second path or by an external CW generator [43].  
For receiver intermodulation, the interfering signals are a CW signal and a QPSK-modulated NR signal, with the NR interferer generated in baseband B and the CW interferer generated by the SMW second RF path or by an external signal generator such as R&S SGS100A or R&S SMA100B [42].  
For transmitter intermodulation, an extra interfering signal is required, and it can be generated by R&S SMW200A or R&S SMBV100B with the -K144 5G NR software option [51].  
### Role of the signal analyzer
The signal analyzer measures and verifies the RF output, spectrum, modulation, and emissions behavior of the device under test, as shown by the conducted transmitter setup where the R&S FSW spectrum analyzer executes measurements such as output power, frequency error, modulation quality, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, OBUE/SEM, and transmitter spurious emissions [50].  
Receiver spurious emissions testing does not need a signal generator but does need a signal and spectrum analyzer, and the listed analyzers include R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, and R&S FPS [41].  
R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, with R&S FSW85 plus R&S FSW-B90G extending to 90 GHz [9].  
R&S FSVA3000 is a signal and spectrum analyzer product family with models from 10 Hz to 4 GHz, 7.5 GHz, 13.6 GHz, 30 GHz, 44 GHz, and 50 GHz [13].  
R&S FSW analysis bandwidth hardware options range from 40 MHz up to 8.312 GHz depending on option and model applicability [11].  
R&S FSVA3000 signal analysis bandwidth is 28 MHz nominal standard and can be optioned to 40 MHz, 200 MHz, 400 MHz, 600 MHz, or 1000 MHz nominal [16].  
【推論】In an RFIC validation bench, the signal generator is the controllable stimulus and interferer source, while the signal analyzer is the measurement instrument for RF output quality, spectrum, and emissions, based on the cited receiver, transmitter, and laboratory RF test workflows [26][34][41][42][43][47][50].

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S SMW200A › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.92`。
- 文件版次：`Version 06.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Base unit：`R&S®SMW200A`，Order No. `1412.0000.02`。
- 原文說明：Vector signal generator；includes power cable and quick start guide。
- Base unit can only be ordered with an `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option and an `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` or `R&S®SMW-B13XT` signal routing and baseband main module。
- 最低配置必須包含 RF path A 的一個 frequency option，以及一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options 不能 retrofitted。
- Step 2 baseband main module options 可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Remote control、connectors 與一般資料
- Remote control interfaces：IEC 60625 GPIB IEEE-488.2、Ethernet/LAN 10/100/1000BASE-T、USB 3.0 super speed、serial RS-232 via `R&S®TS-USB1`。
- Remote command set：`SCPI 1999.5 or compatible command sets`。
- Ethernet/LAN protocols and services：VISA VXI-11、Telnet/RawEthernet、VNC、FTP、SMB。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path A connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8/40 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter；56/67 GHz options 為 1.85 mm female with wear and tear adapter。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path B connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter。
- Rear panel 包含 REF IN/OUT、INST TRG A/B、USER 4/5/6、EFC、LO IN/OUT、IEEE 488、LAN、USB DEVICE、EXT 1/2、DIG I/Q OUT、HS DIG I/Q OUT 等。
- Rated power when fully equipped：`550 W measured`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped：`750 W measured`。
- Operating temperature range：`0 °C to +45 °C`；with `R&S®SMW-B1056`、`R&S®SMW-B1067`、`R&S®SMW-B1067N`、`R&S®SMW-B1067O` 為 `+5 °C to +45 °C`。
- Dimensions：standard `435 mm × 192 mm × 460 mm`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` 為 `435 mm × 192 mm × 560 mm`。
- Weight：fully equipped `21 kg`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped `30 kg`。
- Non-volatile memory：SSD，`512 Gbyte`。
- Recommended calibration interval：`3 years`，條件 `40 h/week operation in the full range of the specified environmental conditions`。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA receiver test cases
來源涵蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] chapter 7 tests：

| Clause | Test case | 來源摘錄重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | OTA sensitivity | OSDD / EIS level；Directional；不適用 [[BS type 2-O]]；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.3 | OTA reference sensitivity level | EIS_REFSENS；Directional；驗證 OTA REFSENS RoAoA 內 throughput requirement。 |
| 7.4 | OTA dynamic range | Wanted signal 與 AWGN interferer 來自相同方向；Directional；[[BS type 2-O]] requirement 缺漏。 |
| 7.5.1 | OTA adjacent channel selectivity | Wanted signal 搭配 adjacent channel NR interferer；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.5.2 | OTA in-band blocking | General blocking 與 narrowband blocking；interferer sweep；narrowband blocking 僅適用 [[BS type 1-O]]。 |
| 7.6 | OTA out-of-band blocking | CW interferer；需 external CW generator，例如 [[R&S SMA100B]]；含 co-location blocking。 |
| 7.7 | OTA receiver spurious emissions | TDD BS transmitter OFF period；用 [[TRP]] 方式評估 receiver spurious emissions。 |
| 7.8 | OTA receiver intermodulation | 一個 CW interferer 加一個 5G NR interferer；Directional；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.9 | OTA in-channel selectivity | 驗證 receiver 抑制 IQ leakage；指定 resource block locations；throughput ≥ 95%。 |

- Narrow-band intermodulation interferer levels 同樣為 Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。

- Interfering signal mean power：Blocking performance -15.0 dBm；Co-located base station 16.0 dBm。
- CW interferer 可由 SMW second path 或 external CW generator 提供。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation
- 目的：評估 transmitter unit 抑制由 wanted signal 與 interfering signal 經由 antenna、RDN、antenna array 到達 transmitter unit 後，在 non-linear elements 中產生 signal 的能力。
- 測試時將 lowest supported channel bandwidth 的 NR signal 作為 interfering signal 注入 antenna connector。
- Interfering signal 的 mean power level 比 wanted signal 的 mean power 低 30 dB。
- Wanted signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1。
- Interfering signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1，minimum channel bandwidth，15 kHz SCS。
- Interferer level：P rated,t,AC - 30 dB。
- Frequency offset：±0.5 × BW Interferer（n=1）、±1.5 × BW Interferer（n=2）、±2.5 × BW Interferer（n=3）。
- Transmitter intermodulation 的量測條件與 ACLR（6.6.3）、OBUE / SEM（6.6.4）、Transmitter spurious emissions（6.6.5）相同。
- Intermodulation test 中，F1 是 wanted signal，F2 是 interferer。
- SMW manual testing procedure 需要 firmware higher than 4.70.026.51。

RF pre-conformance testing › 來源定義
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 5G NR UE 上市前需要通過符合 [[3GPP]] specifications 的 device certification。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification。
- RF pre-conformance testing 應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題，減少延遲並提升最終產品品質。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution 提供執行 **NR-FR1 Standalone（SA）** test cases 的平台，依據 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] specification。
- Manual verification capabilities 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification。
- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。

- [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI。
- [[R&S CMX-KC661B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- [[R&S CMsequencer]] automated execution / validation / reporting。
- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] selected test cases。

RF pre-conformance testing
[[RF pre-conformance testing]] 是在正式 device certification / conformance testing 前，於研發早期對 RF 行為進行的 design verification；在 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 中，它指 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 執行 selected 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test cases 的 WebGUI workflow。

RF pre-conformance testing › 與 strict conformance testing 的差異
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Application note procedures 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified。
- Pre-conformance testing 目標是在基於 [[3GPP]] specification 的 streamlined procedure 中提供 meaningful results，但不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。
- 嚴格的 RF conformance testing 與 validated test cases 可使用 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

因此本概念頁不可把 [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI pre-conformance workflow 等同正式 certification lab 或 validated conformance test cases。

RF pre-conformance testing › unresolved
- 來源未提供 RF pre-conformance testing 的一般性標準定義；本頁只根據 R&S 1C111 Version 1e 的 usage 建立。
- 來源未提供 formal certification body、lab accreditation 或 GCF / PTCRB procedure。
- 來源未提供所有 RF pre-conformance test cases 的完整 test matrix。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › WebGUI workflow 摘要
典型流程包含：

1. 補償 signal path attenuation。
2. 在 Frequency Dependent Attenuation tab 定義 attenuation tables。
3. 在 RF Connections tab 將 attenuation tables / fixed values 連結到特定 [[RF path]]。
4. 開啟 3GPP Pre-conformance testing workspace。
5. 在 configuration sidebar 設定 band 與 frequency settings。
6. 啟動 network emulation 並使 cell Go Live。
7. 確認 [[DUT]] 已連接。
8. 選擇 test case 與 Test ID。
9. Test ID 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] tables 設定 RB allocation 與 modulation scheme。
10. 點擊 Apply 執行 test case。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 以簡報方式補充此 workflow 的 sales wording：3GPP Pre-Conformance Wizard takes care of 3GPP RMC settings，並可在 GUI 中 quick and easy 進行 3GPP pre-conformance testing。

Short answer: Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the early laboratory RF validation bench, before field link validation and commercialization readiness, because the cited RF component/semiconductor workflow places R&S signal generation and FSW spectrum analysis in the “laboratory RF test” phase that measures G/T, NF, Tx power, and link equation items around PA/LNA/modem components [26].
### Where they fit in the RFIC validation workflow
The cited semiconductor/RF component context lists Qorvo, Analog Devices, Skyworks, MediaTek M80, SatixFy Sx3099, and Prime ASIC in an RF component / semiconductor section [24].  
The cited OneWeb UT validation workflow is divided into month 1–3 laboratory RF test, month 3–5 field link validation, and month 5–7 commercialization readiness [26].  
The laboratory RF test phase includes G/T, NF, Tx power, link equation measurements, and mentions Qorvo PA, Analog Devices LNA, MediaTek M80, and Rohde & Schwarz SMW6 / R&S FSW [26].  
Therefore, for an RFIC validation use case, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer belong in the lab RF test and debug bench before field link validation [26].  
### Role of the signal generator
The signal generator provides controlled RF/vector-modulated stimulus into the receiver, transmitter, or RF front-end under test, as shown by OTA reference sensitivity testing where the R&S SMW200A sends a 5G NR test signal and throughput is measured [34].  
Receiver tests list R&S SMW200A and R&S SMBV100B as vector signal generators, and the receiver tests need the 5G NR software option R&S SMW200A-/SMBV100B-K144 [41].  
For receiver dynamic range testing, the receiver is evaluated while an AWGN interfering signal is present inside the received channel bandwidth [46].  
For adjacent channel selectivity, the receiver is evaluated while an adjacent-channel interfering signal is present at the assigned channel frequency [47].  
For in-band blocking, the NR interfering signal center frequency is scanned in 1 MHz steps, and narrow-band blocking uses an interfering signal containing one resource block [45].  
For out-of-band blocking, the CW interferer can be supplied by the SMW second path or by an external CW generator [43].  
For receiver intermodulation, the interfering signals are a CW signal and a QPSK-modulated NR signal, with the NR interferer generated in baseband B and the CW interferer generated by the SMW second RF path or by an external signal generator such as R&S SGS100A or R&S SMA100B [42].  
For transmitter intermodulation, an extra interfering signal is required, and it can be generated by R&S SMW200A or R&S SMBV100B with the -K144 5G NR software option [51].  
### Role of the signal analyzer
The signal analyzer measures and verifies the RF output, spectrum, modulation, and emissions behavior of the device under test, as shown by the conducted transmitter setup where the R&S FSW spectrum analyzer executes measurements such as output power, frequency error, modulation quality, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, OBUE/SEM, and transmitter spurious emissions [50].  
Receiver spurious emissions testing does not need a signal generator but does need a signal and spectrum analyzer, and the listed analyzers include R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, and R&S FPS [41].  
R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, with R&S FSW85 plus R&S FSW-B90G extending to 90 GHz [9].  
R&S FSVA3000 is a signal and spectrum analyzer product family with models from 10 Hz to 4 GHz, 7.5 GHz, 13.6 GHz, 30 GHz, 44 GHz, and 50 GHz [13].  
R&S FSW analysis bandwidth hardware options range from 40 MHz up to 8.312 GHz depending on option and model applicability [11].  
R&S FSVA3000 signal analysis bandwidth is 28 MHz nominal standard and can be optioned to 40 MHz, 200 MHz, 400 MHz, 600 MHz, or 1000 MHz nominal [16].  
【推論】In an RFIC validation bench, the signal generator is the controllable stimulus and interferer source, while the signal analyzer is the measurement instrument for RF output quality, spectrum, and emissions, based on the cited receiver, transmitter, and laboratory RF test workflows [26][34][41][42][43][47][50].

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.7 Receiver Intermodulation
- Intermodulation response rejection 衡量 receiver 在 two interfering signals 存在下於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Interfering signals 是 CW signal 與 QPSK modulation 的 NR signal。
- NR interferer 在 baseband B 產生；CW interferer 可由 SMW second RF path 的 `AWGN B` block 產生，或由 external signal generator 產生，例如 [[R&S SGS100A]] 或 [[R&S SMA100B]]。
- General intermodulation interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Narrow-band intermodulation interferer levels 同樣為 Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC77`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.5 Out-of-band Blocking
- CW interfering signal center frequency 以 1 MHz step size 掃頻。
- 掃頻範圍來源中列為 1 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；另有一處文字列為 1 MHz 到 12.57 GHz，需回原文確認。
- Wanted level = [[3GPP TS 38.104]] reference sensitivity level + 6 dB。
- Interfering signal mean power：Blocking performance -15.0 dBm；Co-located base station 16.0 dBm。
- CW interferer 可由 SMW second path 或 external CW generator 提供。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC75`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.4.2 In-band Blocking
- General in-band blocking：NR interfering signal center frequency 以 1 MHz step size 掃描。
- General blocking 中，interfering signal mean power：Wide area -43.0 dBm；Medium range -38.0 dBm；Local area -35.0 dBm。
- Narrow-band blocking 類似 ACS，但 interfering signal 只包含 1 resource block。
- Narrow band blocking interfering level：Wide area -49.0 dBm；Medium range -44.0 dBm；Local area -41.0 dBm。
- General blocking SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC742A`。
- Narrow-band blocking SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC742B`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.3 Dynamic Range
- Dynamic range 衡量 receiver 在 received channel bandwidth 內存在 AWGN interfering signal 時接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- 每個 measured NR carrier 的 throughput 必須 ≥ possible maximum throughput 的 95%。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC73`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.4.1 Adjacent Channel Selectivity
- ACS 衡量 receiver 在相鄰通道 interfering signal 存在時，於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Uplink interfering signal 使用 QPSK modulation。
- Wanted level = [[3GPP TS 38.104]] reference sensitivity level + 6 dB。
- ACS NR interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Interferer 是 DFT-s-OFDM signal，QPSK modulation。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC741`。
